verses.text: Wisdom is calling out! Understanding is raising her voice!
She stands on the hilltops along the road, where the paths meet.
Beside the gates leading into the city, at the entrances, she cries out:
"I am calling to you, all people! I am speaking to everyone.
You simple people, learn good sense! You fools, gain understanding!
Listen, because I have important things to say. Everything I say is right.
My mouth speaks the truth. My lips hate what is evil.
Everything I say is right. None of it is crooked or twisted.
It is all clear to those who understand, and right to those who have knowledge.
Choose my teaching instead of silver, and knowledge instead of pure gold.
Wisdom is worth more than rubies. Nothing you could want compares with her.
I, wisdom, live together with good sense. I have knowledge and good judgment.
To respect the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, boasting, evil ways, and twisted words.
Good advice and sound wisdom belong to me. I have understanding and power.
Through me kings rule, and rulers make fair laws.
Through me princes govern, and all the nobles who rule the earth fairly.
I love those who love me. Those who look for me will find me.
Riches and honour are with me, lasting wealth and success.
What I give is better than the finest gold. What I produce is better than pure silver.
I walk on the path of what is right, along the paths of justice.
I give wealth to those who love me, and I fill their storerooms.
The LORD had me at the very beginning of his work, before he did anything else long ago.
I was formed long ages ago, at the very beginning, before the earth was made.
I was born before the deep oceans existed, before there were springs full of water.
I was born before the mountains were set in place, before the hills,
before he made the earth and its fields, or even the first grains of dust in the world.
I was there when he set the skies in place, when he marked the horizon on the face of the deep sea,
when he put the clouds above and made the springs of the deep flow strongly,
when he set the limits of the sea so the waters would not go beyond his command, when he marked out the foundations of the earth.
I was the skilled worker at his side. I was his delight day after day, always happy in his presence,
happy with the whole world he made, and delighted with the human race.
So now, my children, listen to me. Happy are those who follow my ways.
Listen to my teaching and be wise. Do not ignore it.
Happy is the person who listens to me, watching every day at my gates, waiting beside my doorway.
Whoever finds me finds life and receives kindness from the LORD.
But whoever misses me harms himself. Everyone who hates me loves death."
